findings.evidence: Line 32 `public structure IntervalPartition`; all referencing theorems at lines 191–604 are non-public; public API starts at line 607 and none mention it.
findings.fix: Drop `public` from the structure (and thus from the exported simp/grind attributes); the non-public theorems referencing it may keep referring to a module-private type.
findings.issue: `IntervalPartition` is `public` yet its own docstring calls it "A proof-local partition"; it is used only by non-public tube lemmas, and its `[simp, grind =]` fields `t_zero`/`t_last` (line 44) then leak into the global simp/grind sets. No public endpoint (lines 607–671) references it.

findings.evidence: Line 58 `public structure TubeData`; all uses are in non-public theorems (lines 191–604); public endpoints at lines 607–671 expose only `Path.Homotopic.Quotient` / path-space openness, not `TubeData`.
findings.fix: Drop `public` from `structure TubeData`; the non-public consumers can still reference it.
findings.issue: `TubeData` is `public` but is proof-local scaffolding for the tube construction; it appears only in non-public theorem signatures (`exists_pathHomotopyTrivial_tube`, `TubeData.isOpen`, `tube_subset_homotopy_class`, …), never in the Stage 0.1 product API.

summary: The Stage 0.1 product API (discreteness instance and the open-homotopy-class lemmas) is minimal and complete, but the proof-local tube scaffolding IntervalPartition and TubeData are still exported as public structures with no public consumer.
